sources.title: Krea2 Raw/Base & Turbo (BF16/FP8/NVFP4/INT8) High Quality Image Gen
sources.snippet: Basically Krea team released two variants- (a) Krea2 Raw (Base) -The Raw checkpoint is designed primarily as a foundation model rather than a final image-generation model. It is not recommended for direct inference/image gen use because its main purpose is customization and further training.
